name: n8n
tested: offline only (fake network); not yet run against a real account
gaps: Parameters and body fields come from each operation's own YAML file. Body fields are the top-level properties of the inline request schema; nested fields are not mapped.
Response schemas and shared error responses were not mapped; they are not inputs.
The spec's own paths block is empty; the paths come from openapi.decorator-routes.generated.yml, which is the doc_url for every operation.
The docs pages do not list an endpoint count, so reference_index_count is null.
Base URL is per instance: the docs give https:// /api/v1 for self-hosted; n8n Cloud uses its own domain.
